description:
## Goal

A held-out eval set + harness that measures recall@K on surface routing. Runs in CI so retrieval quality does not silently regress as the index schema or embedding model changes.

## Expected Work

- Eval set per research (pairs of user message + correct surface id).
- Harness that runs every commit touching retrieval code or descriptors.
- Report: recall@1, recall@3, recall@10. Category breakdowns (tool vs CLI command vs widget).
- CI gate: fail if recall drops below a configurable threshold.
- Surface a human-readable report.

## Acceptance

- Baseline numbers established against v1 index.
- CI gate fires on a deliberately bad change.
- Report is actionable (identifies which surfaces regressed).
name: agent-inbox-retrieval-eval-harness
title: Ship a retrieval routing-eval harness with CI regression gate
